announcements.title: Development Resumed — 1.0.59
announcements.message:
NanaPlay is back! Version 1.0.59 brings a big bug-fix batch: your display name no longer leaks into diagnostics, the Indonesian language option actually works now, local music playlists survive app restarts, stream reconnects are more reliable, and music keeps playing in the background with lock-screen controls. Update from the Settings page. Happy gaming!

NanaPlay kembali! Versi 1.0.59 membawa banyak perbaikan bug: nama tampilan tidak lagi bocor ke diagnostics, opsi Bahasa Indonesia sekarang benar-benar berfungsi, playlist musik lokal tidak hilang saat aplikasi dibuka ulang, reconnect stream lebih andal, dan musik tetap jalan di background dengan kontrol lock-screen. Update dari halaman Settings. Selamat bermain!

announcements.title: A Note on Updates
announcements.message:
A quick note from Papah: NanaPlay updates have been less frequent lately — mainly because bug reports and suggestions from users have also been rare, and I am currently busy building a brand-new app project as well. But do not worry: NanaPlay will keep receiving updates whenever there are fixes, reports, or suggestions from you. Sorry for the long wait, and thank you for sticking around!

Catatan singkat dari Papah: update NanaPlay belakangan ini memang agak jarang — terutama karena laporan bug dan masukan dari kalian juga jarang masuk, dan aku lagi sibuk bikin project aplikasi baru juga. Tapi tenang: NanaPlay akan tetap di-update setiap ada perbaikan, laporan, ataupun saran dari kalian. Mohon maaf jika kalian lama menunggu update, dan terima kasih sudah setia!
